name: Madison County, AL
findings: Madison County has 1,200 nonprofit organizations. 510 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 399 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Madison County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few professional organizations list membership
observations.text: 16 professional organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 32 would.

confidence.text: Based on 32 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through professional groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Research and think tank organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 13 research and think tank organizations here list public events, compared with about 5 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do research and think tank organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 94 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 94 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
